title: Gaudi done proper
text: You can’t visit Barcelona without visiting Gaudi’s amazing works. And having someone walk you through Sagrada Família with insight and history allows you to enjoy it so much more. Our guide, Vitaliy, was great and passionate about Gaudi which really made this tour and our day with him especially engaging.
author: Passenger43763032537

title: Barcelona and Gaudi. What a great tour!
text: Vitaliy was great. Knowledgeable and so familiar with the sites that he was able to bring them alive for us. It rained but that didn’t stop us from moving forward and seeing the Gaudi masterpieces.  Great tour!
author: thomasrK729BJ

title: VIP Private Gaudi Tour of Barcelona
text:
Our LIV Tours private Gaudí tour of Barcelona with Teresa was entertaining, well-paced and informative.

We started at the Sagrada Família with fast-track tickets and plenty of time to explore both the interior and exterior. From there, we had a seamless taxi ride up to Park Güell, where we enjoyed a fascinating and entertaining walk around the park, with some excellent views over Barcelona.

Then it was another quick taxi hop to Casa Vicens, Gaudí’s first commission, where we went inside.

Finally, we walked past the exteriors of two of Gaudí’s most well-known apartment buildings, Casa Batlló
author: Pioneer09359267224

title: Gaudi Private Tour was amazing!
text: We did the VIP Gaudí tour with Valentina and she was amazing! She was incredibly knowledgeable but shared everything in such an easy, engaging way—it never felt like too much. We learned so much without ever feeling overwhelmed, and her passion really came through. It was one of the highlights of our time in Barcelona!
author: Nomad39894869156

title: Fantastic tour
text: The tour was amazing.  We did the privat Gaudi tour with Olga. Familia Segrada is a must see.  Our tour guide Olga was wonderful.  She was fun, engaging, and full of knowledge. She knew all the best places to get pictures and really added to our enjoyment of the trip.  Thank you, Olga!
